query: This README intro reads like ChatGPT wrote it: 'a robust, seamless, cutting-edge solution that empowers developers'. Rewrite README.md's first three sections so it sounds like a person wrote it, same info.
can you de-slop my PR description? it's in pr-body.md. full of em dashes and 'this pivotal change underscores our commitment to quality' lol
Edit docs/user-guide.md so it reads naturally. Reviewers said it has that generated feel: every sentence the same length, lots of 'Additionally', bold headers on every bullet.

I wrote this blog post draft (drafts/kafka-lessons.md) with help from an LLM and now it sounds like a press release. Make it sound like me - here's an older post of mine for voice: posts/2022-retro.md
Our business case doc ends with 'The future looks bright as we continue this exciting journey.' and the whole thing is like that. Clean up docs/business-case.md so leadership doesn't roll their eyes.
rewrite these user stories in stories.md, they're stuffed with 'seamlessly', 'leverage', 'holistic'. keep every acceptance criterion
The docstrings in src/scheduler.py are weirdly flowery ('This function serves as a testament to...'). Make them plain without touching the code.
Take the technical design section in docs/design/cqrs.md and make it readable for both our PMs and backend engineers without dropping any of the technical facts.
My commit message body for the last commit is three paragraphs of 'Not only does this X, it also Y' fluff. Draft a replacement message (don't amend, just give me text).
Go over release-announcement.md and strip the AI tells: rule of three everywhere, 'Let's dive in', emojis in headings, curly quotes.
Remove comments in src/cache.ts that narrate history like 'previously used a Map' or 'fixed in review round 2'.
Score docs/design/search.md 1-5 for review readiness: missing sections, unsupported latency claims, YAGNI violations.
Check the button labels and error messages in src/i18n/en.json for consistency with our UI text style guide (sentence case, no exclamation marks).
Is this essay AI-generated? Give me a probability and evidence. essay.txt
Translate docs/user-guide.md into Spanish, keeping the markdown structure.
Fix grammar and spelling in CONTRIBUTING.md only, don't change wording otherwise.
Summarize this 40-page RFC (rfc.pdf) into a one-paragraph abstract.
Write a design doc for our new rate limiter from scratch.
Convert docs/*.md to a Docusaurus site with a sidebar.
Write the PR for my branch feat/export and open it as a draft on GitHub.
